variables.reason: The candidate labels and definition match the curated KB entry pq_arithmetic_mean_roughness: canonical_quantity 'arithmetic mean roughness' with symbols Ra and aliases 'first-order moment of height fluctuations'. The KB record explicitly defines Ra as the mean absolute deviation of surface height (same physical quantity used in the typed ledger) and lists si_dimension: L with dimension_vector indicating a single length exponent. That KB record therefore supports every nonzero coordinate of the proposed SI vector (only L=1) and confirms all other base exponents are zero.

The typed ledger describes kt as 'peak-to-valley height', which directly corresponds to the KB record pq_peak_to_valley_height whose canonical_quantity is 'mean peak-to-valley roughness height' and which states si_dimension: L. The KB record's definition and domain (surface roughness) match the ledger's use of kt as a length-scale roughness amplitude; hence it supports the candidate SI vector (L=1, all other exponents 0).

The candidate k_rms is defined as RMS height; the KB entry pq_rms_roughness_height has canonical_quantity 'root-mean-square roughness height' with symbols k_rms and si_dimension: L. That KB record's definition (RMS fluctuation of surface height about its mean) matches the ledger variable and supports the proposed SI vector with only L=1 nonzero.

The ledger defines Sk as the normalized third central moment (skewness). KB entry pq_height_skewness explicitly gives canonical_quantity 'surface-height skewness' with symbols Sk and notes 'third standardized moment' and si_dimension: 1 (dimensionless). That record therefore fully supports the candidate SI vector of all zeros.

The ledger's Ku is described as kurtosis (fourth standardized moment). KB entry pq_height_kurtosis lists 'surface-height kurtosis' with si_dimension: 1 and matches the ledger definition, supporting the all-zero SI exponent vector (dimensionless).

The ledger defines ES as an effective streamwise slope (ratio of vertical to horizontal length scales). KB entry pq_effective_surface_slope gives 'effective surface slope' with definition 'mean absolute gradient of surface height in a specified horizontal direction' and explicitly notes a surface-height derivative is length divided by length and is dimensionless (si_dimension: 1). Thus the KB record supports the proposed all-zero SI exponent vector for ES.

Po is given as surface porosity (fraction of surface area occupied by pores). KB entry pq_porosity (porosity) defines porosity as a fraction/void fraction and marks si_dimension: 1 (dimensionless). This KB record thus directly supports the ledger's all-zero SI exponent vector for Po.

candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Given the seven inputs there are three independent dimensional quantities (Ra, kt, k_rms) with dimension of length and four dimensionless shape parameters (Sk, Ku, ES, Po). Therefore the target normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness ks/Ra is dimensionless and can be expressed as a function of the dimensionless groups formed by dividing the length scales by Ra and the four dimensionless parameters: ks/Ra = f(kt/Ra, k_rms/Ra, Sk, Ku, ES, Po).

variables.physical_definition: Arithmetical mean of absolute deviations of surface height from the mean plane (first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations).
Peak-to-valley height: vertical distance between highest peak and deepest valley of the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height: square root of the mean of squared deviations of surface height from the mean plane.
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations divided by the cube of the rms height (normalized third moment).
Dimensionless kurtosis: fourth standardized moment of the surface height distribution (kurtosis).
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness: characteristic slope in the flow (ratio of vertical to horizontal length scales).
Surface porosity: fraction of surface area occupied by pores or voids (dimensionless, between 0 and 1).

variables.physical_definition: Arithmetical mean of absolute deviations of surface height from the mean plane (first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations).
Peak-to-valley height: vertical distance between highest peak and deepest valley of the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height: square root of the mean of squared deviations of surface height from the mean plane.
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations divided by the cube of the rms height (normalized third moment).
Dimensionless kurtosis: fourth standardized moment of the surface height distribution (kurtosis).
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness: characteristic slope in the flow (ratio of vertical to horizontal length scales).
Surface porosity: fraction of surface area occupied by pores or voids (dimensionless, between 0 and 1).
